messages:
Maria L.: Heads up — PioneerMetrics just asked to size up their Dedicated pool for Q4 to support a big seasonal ad push. They want a fast answer on GPU hours + cost delta. Any initial numbers?
Sam P.: Do we know their target uplift?
Maria L.: They pitched +25% baseline GPU hours and expect peaks ~3.2K requests/s for a short window. They also demand eu-west-1 only (data residency).
Keith Z.: Got telemetry from last month. They run an MPT-ish model at 8k context. Measured per-A100-80GB (quantized path) steady throughput ~120 req/s at ~32 tokens/request. Cache hits reduce tokens for repeats.
Sam P.: Ok quick mapping — if peak is 3200 req/s and avg 32 tokens: tokens/s = 3200*32 = 102400 t/s. tokens/hr = 102400*3600 = 368,640,000 t/hr. We measure ~1.8e9 tokens per GPU-hour (q8 path), so raw GPU-hours = 368640000/1.8e9 ≈ 0.205 h per peak hour -> about 5 GPUs per sustained 1k req/s? (rough)
Maria L.: That matches my back-of-envelope. But because they want eu-west-1 only and short spikes, we should offer a "contingency reserve" (not full reserved buffer) plus a small burst wallet. Suggested proposal: reserve 120 GPUs monthly + 20-GPU contingency reserve for safety, and allow bursting up to additional 40 GPUs from market with pre-negotiated burst rate.
Elaine R.: Important: eu-west-1 currently has constrained spare racks for A100s during Oct-Nov. Cross-AZ egress limits and AZ placement matter — we may need colocated capacity in eu-west-1b specifically. That reduces effective spare pool.
infra-bot: current_spare_pool_eu-west-1: 24 GPUs available for immediate allocation.
Sam P.: With only 24 spare, our "40 GPU market burst" is optimistic. We need to either shrink the contingency or commit earlier to secure hardware. Also note price delta if we pin specific AZs (+3% on infra).
Keith Z.: Actionable trade: if Pioneer accepts q4-int8 quantization (automated evals pass) we can lower GPU need by ~18%. That could let us meet peak with reserve 100 + contingency 15 + burst 30.
Maria L.: Can we get a crisp cost delta for sales? Something like: reserve 120 GPUs = base $Xk/month, contingency 20 @ contingency-rate, burst wallet (40 GPU-hr credit) billed on use at burst-rate. Provide two options: (A) standard (no quant) and (B) discounted if they accept quant plan.
Sam P.: I'll draft numbers. Quick example calc in thread to sanity-check:
```
# rough calc (example)
peak_req = 3200
avg_tokens = 32
tokens_per_hour = peak_req * avg_tokens * 3600  # = 368,640,000
tokens_per_gpu_hour = 1.8e9
gpu_hours_peak = tokens_per_hour / tokens_per_gpu_hour  # ≈ 0.205 * hours at peak per GPU
# For a 3-hour sustained peak -> gpu_hours_needed ≈ 0.205*3*number_of_parallel_slots -> translate to GPUs ~ 60ish depending on concurrency
```
Keith Z.: Fine grain numbers after Sam's draft. Also add a note: network egress cap in eu-west-1 could throttle multi-AZ fanout during coldstart; recommend warm pool sizing for model coldstarts.
Elaine R.: I'll call infra procurement — ask them to check spot availability and AZ pin pricing for the Oct-Nov timeframe.
Maria L.: Plan: Sam to produce two-option cost sheet + assumptions, Keith to validate throughput-to-GPU mapping, Elaine to confirm AZ availability. If procurement confirms we can't meet burst from spare pool, we move to earlier hardware commitment.
Sam P.: On it. Will ping with draft within 24h. :+1:
Keith Z.: Adding caveat: if Pioneer insists on single-AZ placement we should include a clause for increased SLA risk and higher price.
Maria L.: Perfect. Once numbers are ready I'll loop in sales and account exec. Thanks everyone.
